page: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure VM.Standard.E6.Flex.16-128 is a flexible general-purpose virtual machine configuration based on x86_64 architecture. The instance is powered by dedicated AMD EPYC 9J45 processors operating at a base frequency of 2.7 GHz. The hardware layout allocates 16 physical cores and 32 virtual CPUs (vCPUs) with simultaneous multithreading active at two threads per core. System memory totals 128.0 GB of RAM, offering a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of memory per vCPU.

This server type does not feature integrated local storage or hardware-based graphics processing units. All persistent disk operations necessitate the attachment of external network block volumes. Network connectivity includes one complimentary public IPv4 address. The absence of local solid-state drives minimizes non-volatile storage overhead at the compute tier while allowing storage capacity to scale separately from processing resources.

The 1:4 processor-to-memory balance positions this instance as an efficient resource allocation for mid-to-large enterprise workloads requiring consistent multi-threaded compute. Typical applications include application backends, relational databases relying on remote block storage, container cluster worker nodes, continuous integration pipelines, and general enterprise application hosting.
description: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure VM.Standard.E6.Flex.16-128 is a general-purpose virtual machine based on the x86_64 architecture, powered by AMD EPYC 9J45 processors operating at 2.7 GHz. The instance delivers 16 physical cores configured with multithreading to present 32 dedicated vCPUs, paired with 128.0 GB of system memory. This configuration provides a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU, aligning with standard enterprise application requirements. The server includes no integrated GPU hardware and has no local ephemeral storage, directing all data persistence through attached remote block storage solutions. One complimentary public IPv4 address is provided for external network access. The hardware profile offers balanced compute density and memory capacity suitable for horizontal scaling of enterprise software, medium-scale relational databases, container orchestration nodes, backend web services, and automated build pipelines that require stable, dedicated x86 execution environments.
